column1: # SigProfilerMatrixGenerator mm10 corrected TSB source manifest
# The historical package documented Ensembl database version "93.38". Verifying
# the bundled transcript set against every candidate release found an exact,
# zero-diff match only at Ensembl release 94 (0 bundled transcripts retired or
# reclassified, 58 additional protein-coding transcripts present in release 94
# absent from the bundle). Release 94 is used as the actual annotation source;
# see README.md for the verification method. FASTA sequence content is
# byte-identical between release 93 and release 94 (confirmed by direct
# decompressed diff for all 22 chromosomes); only the gzip container differs,
# so the FASTA sha256/bsd sum values below are release-94-specific but the
# underlying sequence matches release 93 as well.
